Welcome to Eaton Square Prep School
Welcome to Eaton Square Prep School, an outstanding coeducational independent school for Pre-Nursery to Year 6, located in London, where education feels like a second home. We believe in creating a warm, safe, and happy environment for every child. From the moment they arrive, greeted with a handshake and a “Good morning,” our pupils learn the values of respect and high standards.
Our academic excellence is evident in our Year 6 results, with many pupils earning scholarships. Our smart uniform symbolises the pride and responsibility of representing our school. We blend traditional prep school education with a forward-thinking approach, ensuring our enriched curriculum prepares children for senior school and beyond.
Explore Eaton Square and experience the warmth, respect, and excellence that define our education.

Admissions
We welcome children to start at Eaton Square in Pre-Nursery, Nursery, or Reception. We also accept applications for occasional places, though these are limited.

Frequently Asked Questions
What age does Eaton Square Prep School start from?
We welcome children from Pre-Nursery through to Year 6, with the main entry points at Pre-Nursery, Nursery and Reception. A limited number of occasional places are also available in other year groups.
Where is Eaton Square Prep School located?
We’re based at 55–57 Eccleston Square in Belgravia, Central London (SW1V 1PH), within easy reach of families across Westminster and the wider Central London area.
Is Eaton Square Prep School coeducational?
Yes, we’re a fully coeducational prep school, welcoming both boys and girls from Pre-Nursery to Year 6. Read more about coeducation at Eaton Square →
What is a prep school?
A prep school (short for “preparatory school”) educates children from the early years through to age 11 or 13, preparing them academically and personally for entry to senior school.
How do I book a visit or Open Morning?
The best way to experience Eaton Square Prep School is in person. Book an Open Morning →
What are the fees at Eaton Square Prep School?
Fees vary by year group. View our current fees →
What results do pupils achieve at 11+?
Our most recent Year 6 cohort secured 81 offers and 12 scholarships at 11+.

pageCache.pageTitle: Aims & Values | Eaton Square Prep School
pageCache.text:
Our Vision
To equip our pupils with the skills to thrive in an ever-changing world.
Our Mission
To provide an exceptional all-round education.
Our Aims
To deliver a balanced education that focuses on the holistic development of the child.
To cultivate a love for learning in our pupils and to motivate them to excel academically, athletically, and artistically.
To empower our pupils to be happy, confident, and respectful individuals who contribute positively to the world.
Our Values
Perseverance
We will try our absolute best at all we do.
We believe in facing challenges head-on. We understand that mistakes are stepping stones in the learning journey. We aim to foster an environment where every pupil is encouraged to reach their potential.
Ownership
We will take ownership of our own learning and actions.
We promote in our pupils a sense of responsibility towards their learning, actions, and school. As they grow, we guide them towards self-sufficiency.
Integrity
We will conduct ourselves with integrity at all times.
We are committed to nurturing good human beings. We emphasise understanding the difference between right and wrong and always doing the right thing.
Service
We will serve our school, one another and the local, wider and global community to the best of our ability.
We encourage our pupils to serve each other, the school community, and the wider world. We instil the importance of helping those less fortunate through charitable work and supporting the planet by learning about and implementing sustainable practices.
Empathy
We will always aim to help, understand and support others. We will lead by example and always treat others as we would like to be treated.
Watch Our Values Videos Below:
Whole School Assemblies and Values Awards
Each week, our pupils gather for a whole school assembly at St Michael’s Church, Chester Square. This event unites the community, including parents and friends, to celebrate the children’s achievements and to share important announcements.
During these assemblies, a child from each year group is recognised for exemplifying one of our values. This not only commends their accomplishments but also inspires all pupils to embody these values daily.
While the school has a historical Christian ethos, we warmly welcome families and children of all religious denominations.

pageCache.pageTitle: Our Facilities | Eaton Square Prep School
pageCache.text:
At Eaton Square Prep School, we have created and continue to evolve a dynamic learning environment where pupils thrive. Our state-of-the-art facilities, including a new STEAM Centre, and our early adoption of the importance of AI in education, reflect our forward-thinking approach. We embrace the future of technology, ensuring our children are equipped with the safeguards, skills, and knowledge to excel in an ever-evolving world. By fostering creativity, critical thinking, and adaptability, we inspire a love of learning that goes beyond the classroom, preparing our pupils to succeed in both school and life.
Please find details of our facilities below. We also encourage you to book a spot at our next Open Morning for a closer look at our beautiful Belgravia setting.
Library ‘The Barn’
Constructed from reclaimed crates and wood, our rustic library offers a wide range of books and resources. Balancing our STEAM Centre, this space provides a quiet haven for children to read and study.
STEAM Centre ‘The Launch Pad’
Dedicated to Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics, this space features an augmented reality sandpit, a draw alive wall, a dynamic floor, interactive projector displays, and a tablet wall. This is the only one of its kind in the world.
Science Laboratory
An engaging space where children can explore and discover the wonders of science. They can conduct experiments, participate in hands-on activities, and connect with scientists from various fields.
Computing Suite
To complement the digital literacy skills provided through the curriculum, the 1:1 devices for pupils in Years 4-6, and the bank of iPads and digital robots available for our younger pupils, the Computing Suite provides a space for children to learn the skills needed for the digital age.
Art and Design Room
Situated at the top of the building, our Art and Design Room boasts beautiful views of Eccleston Square, providing a constant source of inspiration for our young artists. This dynamic space allows the pupils to explore their laser cutting skills and expand their minds through The Maker Space and the interactive wall. Children can engage in hands-on, collaborative projects. Illuminated tables offer a perfect platform for detailed art and design work. The room has a bright, open feel that encourages exploration and artistic expression.
Music Room
A dedicated space for pupils to explore their musical talents. It supports both lessons and group practices. Individual music lessons are provided in our specially designed, soundproofed music rooms.
Dining Hall
Spanning all three buildings, our large, spacious, and airy dining hall allows children to enjoy nutritious meals together, fostering a sense of community.
Hall
A versatile space used for assemblies, performances, and various events.
External Sites
Park
Years 1 to 6 enjoy outdoor play at Sussex Street Playground, while Nursery and Reception play at St George’s Square.
Physical Education and Swimming
Pupils visit the Queen Mother Sports Centre.
Games and Sports
Held at Battersea Park and other local facilities.
Whole School Assemblies and Concerts
St Michael’s Church, Chester Square is used for our whole school assemblies and concerts, among other venues.
School Productions
London theatres and halls are used to allow Year 5 and 6 pupils to benefit from these professional spaces.

pageCache.pageTitle: Head's Welcome | Eaton Square Prep School
pageCache.text:
Welcome to Eaton Square Prep School, where education feels like a second home. At Eaton Square, we believe that a child’s educational journey should be filled with warmth, safety, and happiness. Our commitment to nurturing each child is at the heart of everything we do.
From the moment they step through our doors, greeted with a handshake and a warm “Good morning,” our children understand the importance of respect, presentation, and the high expectations we set for them.
Academically, we strive for excellence, and our Year 6 results reflect this. Many of our pupils achieve scholarships, a testament to the rigorous yet supportive environment we provide.
Our beautiful, smart uniform is more than just attire; it symbolises the pride and responsibility our children carry in representing our school and themselves. At Eaton Square, we blend the best of a traditional prep school education with a forward-thinking approach.
Our curriculum is enriched, innovative, and creative, ensuring that our children are not only prepared for the challenges of senior school but are also equipped with the core values, confidence, and lifelong love of learning that will serve them throughout their lives.
As they leave us, our Year 6 pupils carry with them not just academic achievements but also fond memories and the ability to present themselves with confidence and creativity. These are the experiences and values that will last a lifetime, making their time at Eaton Square special.
I invite you to explore our school and discover the warmth, respect, and excellence that define an Eaton Square Prep School education.
Trish Watt Headmistress

Clubs
At Eaton Square Prep School, we offer a wide variety of after-school activities. We believe it is paramount to give our pupils as much breadth as possible and access to sporting, academic, creative, and performance-based clubs, which will fully enhance their learning experience.
Benefits of After-School Clubs
After-school clubs provide a unique chance for children to work together in a relaxed, non-academic setting. They can share their sporting or creative passions with their teacher, allowing them to build new and fulfilling friendships with adults and peers alike. In some cases, club sessions also provide the opportunity for pupils to take part in activities with children from different year groups, which is enriching and helps to build the community of the school.

Wraparound Care
We are excited to introduce our new Wraparound Care programme at Eaton Square for children aged 3-11. This service, provided in partnership with Premier Education, runs from 3.30pm to 6.00pm.
Our Wraparound Care offers top-quality, Ofsted-registered care with a variety of fun and stimulating activities in a safe and secure environment. This programme is designed to support busy parents by extending the school day and enhancing the curriculum.
We look forward to welcoming your children to our Wraparound Care programme and supporting your family with this extended service.

pageCache.pageTitle: Equality & EDI | Eaton Square Prep School
pageCache.text:
Our Commitment
At Eaton Square Prep School, we believe that diversity enriches our community. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every child feels valued and respected. Our diverse pupil body, representing various backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives, enhances the learning experience for everyone.
Inclusive Teaching and Learning
As recognised by the Independent Schools Inspectorate (ISI), we are proud of our significant strength in inclusion. We ensure that every pupil is supported to reach their full potential. Whether they are more able or need additional support, our tailored approach enables pupils to make rapid progress in all areas of their development. Our inclusive ethos and dedication to individual growth provide each child with the opportunities, resources, and encouragement needed to thrive academically, socially, and emotionally.
By incorporating diverse cultural, social, and historical contexts into our curriculum, we foster a deeper understanding and appreciation of the world. Additionally, we offer a wide range of extracurricular activities to support the holistic development of our pupils, allowing them to explore their interests, develop new skills, and build lasting friendships.
Supportive Environment
Our goal is to create a supportive environment where every pupil feels safe, respected, and encouraged to reach their full potential. Our school community is built on mutual respect and understanding, ensuring all children have access to the resources and assistance they need. From language development to guidance and counselling to individualised education plans, we provide a nurturing atmosphere that promotes academic success and personal growth.
Community Engagement
Eaton Square values community engagement and encourages pupils to participate in activities that promote diversity and inclusion. We host events that celebrate different cultures and traditions, fostering unity and understanding within our school community.
Continuous Improvement
We are committed to continuous improvement in our diversity and inclusion efforts. We regularly review our policies and practices to ensure they align with our values and meet the needs of our community. We welcome feedback from children, parents, and staff to help us create a more inclusive environment for everyone.

At Eaton Square Schools, we believe that the impact of a strong EYFS curriculum is that all children make progress from their individual starting point. All children get the best possible start to their school life and develop the knowledge and skills to reach their full potential. They develop and nurture strong, positive attitudes, and become proud and respectful of themselves, others, and their environment. This allows them to carry with them the knowledge, skills, and attitudes which will make them lifelong learners and valuable future citizens.
We follow the Statutory Framework for the Early Years Foundation Stage. We also have our own EYFS Curriculum Policy, in which you will find information about the EYFS areas of learning, how we support the children’s development in all areas, as well as the Early Learning Goals, and much more information.

The Nursery and Reception class teachers share their class timetable, as well as the Medium-Term Plan, with parents at the beginning of every term, along with a Welcome Letter. In this letter, they provide important information about the upcoming term, including key dates for the diary. We base our planning on the children’s interests, and we welcome parents to participate in our planning by contributing their ideas and thoughts. We believe that parents are their children’s first educators, and every effort is made to inform them about the EYFS curriculum, providing them with the tools to support continued learning at home. Parents are also encouraged to inform the school about their child’s interests and achievements at home, as these are essential parts of each child’s learning journey.
The weekly planning is displayed on the notice boards in every classroom, and parents often check what their children will be learning during the day at drop-off time. We also use Tapestry as a way to record the children’s learning journey and share those special moments with their parents. Parents are also welcome to upload their observations from home. When a child reaches the end of the EYFS, we create a very special document detailing their learning journey from their first day at Eaton Square Schools. Eaton Square Nursery children enjoy an immense range of enriching activities beyond their curriculum-led experiences.
From learning to swim with a professional swim coach to creating artwork for a charity auction, it is in these moments that children can begin to develop their love of sporting and creative pursuits, igniting sparks that will fire lifelong passions.
Children likewise can benefit from our regular trips to the likes of Forest School, London Wetlands Centre and the Royal Parks.
We also encourage children to develop their performance skills, strengthening their confidence and ability to communicate. Parents are most welcome at these events, with annual highlights including the Christmas Performance, Easter Bonnet Parade and Graduation Ceremony.

pageCache.pageTitle: School Trips | Eaton Square Prep School
pageCache.text:
At Eaton Square Prep School, we organise a variety of educational, engaging, and inspiring excursions throughout the year. These trips help our pupils gain valuable life skills, broaden their horizons, and create lasting memories.
Nursery Visits
Our Nursery children enjoy local outings. They visit Churchill Gardens or St George’s Square three to four times a week for park activities. Once a week, they head to the Queen Mother Sports Centre for swimming and regularly participate in Forest School sessions.
Prep Visits
Prep pupils have the chance to explore further afield and use London as their extended classroom. They regularly travel to Kew Gardens, Fulham Palace, Horniman Museum, Tower of London, various theatres, Warner Bros. Studio, British Museum, Natural History Museum, Science Museum, Hampton Court Palace, Young V&A, Living Rainforest, Greenwich, Florence Nightingale Museum, Cutty Sark, and Battersea Park Children’s Zoo.
Residential Trips
From Year 2 onwards, each year group embarks on exciting residential journeys beyond London. Notable experiences include the Years 2 and 3 adventures to Sayers Croft, the Year 4 exploration of Norfolk, the Year 5 ski trip to Norway, and the Year 6 Classical expedition to Italy.
Sports Trips
Our sports teams participate in swimming training in Tenerife and compete in the IAPS Skiing Championships held in Italy. Our Elite Swim Squad travels to national competitions on a regular basis.

pageCache.pageTitle: Book a Visit | Eaton Square Prep School
pageCache.text:
At Eaton Square, we call our open days Open Mornings, and they are the best way to discover what makes our Belgravia prep school special. Whether you join a scheduled Open Morning or arrange an individual tour, you will see our classrooms, meet our staff and pupils, and get a genuine feel for daily life at the school.
Our Next Open Morning
Our next Open Morning is Tuesday 6th October 2026, 9:00 to 10:30am. Booking is quick and easy, and places are limited, so we recommend registering in advance.
What Happens at an Eaton Square Open Day
Every Open Morning follows a similar format, designed to give you and your child a complete picture of life at Eaton Square, from arrival to your last question.
What Families Can Expect to Learn
For Parents
You will come away with a clear picture of our curriculum and values, our approach to pastoral care, our latest 11+ results, and how Eaton Square’s guaranteed placement into a Dukes Education senior school works. Our Admissions team will also be on hand to talk through fees and the registration timeline.
For Prospective Pupils
Children are welcomed by our pupil ambassadors and given the chance to see classrooms in action, explore The Launch Pad STEAM Centre, and get a genuine sense of what a normal school day feels like, well before any decision is made.
Individual Tours
If you are unable to attend a scheduled Open Morning, we are happy to arrange an individual tour at a time that suits you during term time. Individual tours offer a more personal, one-to-one introduction to the school and can be tailored to your specific questions, whether that is our curriculum, pastoral care or the admissions process. Simply contact our team below and we’ll get back to you with availability shortly.
Frequently Asked Questions
What happens at a private school open day at Eaton Square?
You will be welcomed by pupil ambassadors, hear a short talk from a member of our Senior Leadership Team, take a guided tour of the school, and have the chance to meet staff, current parents and pupils. Musical performances and time for questions are also part of the morning.
How long does an Open Morning last?
Our Open Mornings typically run for around 90 minutes, starting at 9:00am. This gives you enough time to tour the school, meet staff and pupils, and ask any questions, without it feeling rushed.
Can my child come to the Open Morning with me?
Yes. We welcome prospective pupils to join their parents on the visit. It is a good opportunity for your child to see the classrooms and meet our pupil ambassadors before deciding if Eaton Square feels right for them.
Do I need to book in advance?
Yes, booking in advance is essential as places are limited. You can register your interest and reserve a place using the Open Morning and Visits form on this page.
What if I cannot attend the scheduled Open Morning?
If our scheduled Open Morning date does not suit you, we are happy to arrange an individual tour at a convenient time during term time, tailored to your questions and interests.
Can international families arrange a visit?
There is nothing you need to bring beyond your questions. Many parents find it helpful to prepare questions in advance about curriculum, class sizes, pastoral care, fees or the admissions timeline.
